An exceptional opportunity to create a bespoke waterfront residence in one of Palm Jumeirah’s most coveted locations.

Situated on a prime high-number frond, this six-bedroom Riviera-style Signature Villa offers spectacular open-water views of the Crescent skyline, Atlantis The Palm and Atlantis The Royal.

Stripped back internally and ready for renovation, the villa presents a blank canvas to create a bespoke luxury home, with generous proportions, direct beach access and a private waterfront setting.

This exceptional villa represents outstanding value compared to other Signature Villas, benefiting from over 1,230 sq. ft. of additional, fully paid-for internal built-up area (BUA), alongside a substantially extended plot.

Together, these valuable enhancements represent an estimated AED 17.5 million in added value, setting the property apart from comparable villas and offering a compelling advantage for prospective buyers.

Whether creating a personalised family residence or pursuing a value-add investment, this is a rare opportunity to unlock the potential of a prime waterfront asset. Interiors can be transformed; location cannot.

Property Highlights:

  • Six bedrooms
  • Prime high-number location

descriptionHtml:
Tranquility pervades all aspects of AVA at Palm Jumeirah. From strolling in the grounds along the waterfront to entering the cool of the atrium; from stepping from the lift into your light-filled residence to standing on your private terrace enthralled by a vista of city and sea, AVA at Palm Jumeirah has been conceived to ensure that each element of your experience is imbued with calm.

As the first building at the threshold of the world- renowned Palm Jumeirah, AVA at Palm Jumeirah occupies an incomparable position right at the very centre of Dubai. It is ideally placed to afford privileged access to both the calm of the waterfront and the dynamism of this global city.

Rising above the water, AVA at Palm Jumeirah Dubai’s organic form brings a distinctive silhouette to Dubai’s skyline. The crown of AVA at Palm Jumeirah is devoted to one of the most sumptuous mega penthouses in the world.

Unique in the truest sense of the word, this residence unites over multiple levels, boasting true elegance in design with a dedication to ensuring every detail is fully considered.

The Sky Palace creates unequivocal space, volume and opportunity to truly explore the limits of what a life well-lived can be in AVA at Palm Jumeirah, Dorchester Collection, Dubai.

Spread over four floors, this incomparable 33,406 sq. ft. residence will garner global attention from those who covet a day in the life of the owner.

The Sky Palace at AVA at Palm Jumeirah, Dorchester Collection, Dubai, affords its own private amenities, alongside exclusive access to the amenities of AVA at Palm Jumeirah, plus working in harmony with its neighbouring tower, One at Palm Jumeirah, also managed by Dorchester Collection.

Situated on the shores of the Gulf, from the very first moment, it is clear that AVA at Palm Jumeirah is beyond compare. Be it an expansive apartment or the palatial Sky Palace covering numerous floors, each residence in AVA at Palm Jumeirah is completely individual your own oasis.

descriptionHtml:
Live Inside the Icon!

There's the Palm Jumeirah, and then there's Atlantis The Royal — the address that redefined what resort living means in Dubai. Now, one of its finest two-bedroom residences is available, and it's unlike anything else on the market.

Marketed by Luxury Realty, the #1 agency at Atlantis The Royal and former developer sales team, this isn't just a listing — it's insider access to the building we know better than anyone.

The Residence!

Branded upgrades throughout. Uninterrupted views across the Palm and the Dubai skyline. 2,388 sq ft (222 sq m) of space finished to a standard that goes well beyond what the developer originally delivered — no expense spared, nothing left to chance.

It's turnkey, it's move-in ready, and it's waiting. Bring your suitcase.

A Resort, Not Just a Residence!

Living here means beachfront access and pools — indoor, outdoor, and everything in between. Air-conditioned cabanas. An outdoor kitchen and BBQ built for entertaining. A tennis court. Private gardens. A resident's lounge and library. A Technogym fitness suite, spa, sauna, and steam room. And round-the-clock white-glove service — concierge and valet included — so every detail is handled before you think to ask.

World-Class Dining, Downstairs!

As a resident, you'll enjoy a 30% dining discount across a culinary line-up most cities would kill for:

Dinner by Heston Blumenthal

Jaleo by José Andrés

Ariana's Persian Kitchen

La Mar by Gastón Acurio

Estiatorio Milos

Nobu by the Beach

Ling Ling — and Carbone, fresh in from New York

See It to Believe It!

No description does this residence justice. Viewings are by discreet private appointment only — contact Luxury Realty today to arrange yours!

descriptionHtml:
Luxury Realty — the home of mansions, penthouses, and branded residences — presents an exquisite opportunity to acquire one of the finest two-bedroom duplex Sky Courts at Atlantis The Royal Residences. As the number one sales and rental agency and former developer sales team for Atlantis The Royal, we are uniquely placed to offer this exceptional home.

Located on the Crescent Road of the Palm Jumeirah, this landmark spans two wings. The hotel offers an incredible array of celebrity chef and Michelin-starred restaurants — such as Dinner by Heston Blumenthal, Estiatorio Milos, La Mar by Gastón Acurio, Ariana's Persian Kitchen, Carbone and Nobu by the Beach — plus a world class spa, boutiques such as Louis Vuitton, extensive resort beachfront, dancing fire-and-water fountain, and one of Dubai's highest infinity pools with incredible Dubai skyline and open sea views.

The residences offer exclusivity and privacy, with facilities including:

  • Private access drive, 24/7 concierge and valet
  • Residents' lounge, library and business rooms
  • Two outdoor pools, cabanas, BBQ, tennis and paddle courts
  • Landscaped gardens, private beach, 20m indoor lap pool
  • Technogym fitness suite, sauna, steam rooms, spa and Zen garden

Residents also enjoy white-glove À la carte service from Atlantis The Royal, including housekeeping, laundry and in-home dining, plus Black-tier membership privileges such as a 30% discount across the resort.

This impressive home measures circa 4,500 sq ft (418 sqm) of internal living area, balcony and terrace with private pool. Available for immediate occupation, brand-new and never occupied, it was masterfully curated by the acclaimed Rigby & Rigby design house of London.

It suits a resident who values privacy, exclusivity and a calm, well-heeled lifestyle, with outstanding hospitality next door whenever the mood calls for it.

Luxury Realty invites expressions of interest — contact us for details and a private viewing by appointment.

ORLA managed by Dorchester Collection, Palm Jumeirah — Four-Bedroom Simplex | 6,818 SqFt (633 SqM) | Dual Aspect Views | Double Height Ceiling | Completion 2027

Luxury Realty presents a rare final opportunity to acquire a fully fitted four-bedroom simplex at ORLA — one of the Palm Jumeirah's most celebrated upcoming branded residences, developed by Omniyat and managed exclusively by the Dorchester Collection.

Spanning 6,818 sqft (633 sqm) across a single expansive floor with dramatic double-height ceiling, the residence commands uninterrupted dual views across the Dubai skyline, the Palm Jumeirah, and the Arabian Gulf. With this configuration and aspect long sold out, availability at this level will not return.

ORLA is a landmark collaboration between the world's foremost design houses. The architecture is by Foster + Partners and SAOTA; interiors are fully tailored by Yodezeen; and the beachside gardens are conceived by ZED Collective. Every surface reflects this pedigree — rare marble, natural timber, premium appliances, and bespoke finishes throughout.

Residents access a curated suite of amenities: private beach, infinity pool, signature spa, fitness suite, cinema, and library lounge. These are complemented by the Dorchester Collection's legendary service — a dedicated residence manager, concierge, valet, and 24-hour doorman.

Positioned on the Crescent Road, the residence connects effortlessly to Dubai Marina, DIFC, Jumeirah, and Downtown.

Completing in 2027, pre-handover pricing presents compelling value with a short runway to delivery.

Register your interest with Luxury Realty to receive the full details!

descriptionHtml:
Welcome to the exceptional!

Luxury Realty, the home of mansions, penthouses and branded residences, is delighted to bring to market this exquisite property within the much-revered Panorama complex in the highly sought-after Views community. Within Panorama, residents enjoy best-in-class facilities, including a swimming pool, sun deck, children’s pool, gymnasium, indoor games room, children’s play area, barbecue area and more, while the central location gives excellent access to lifestyle, schooling, healthcare and retail.

Perfect for families and those with a penchant for golf, this fabulous home commands some of the most breathtaking views in Dubai. From its elevated penthouse position, vistas sweep across Emirates Golf Club towards the Marina, JBR and the Palm skyline – a truly memorable sight at sunset.

A recent renovation elevates the residence well beyond its peers.

Level One: private entrance foyer, beautifully appointed fitted kitchen, open-plan living and dining room with terrace, laundry and utility room, and a guest bathroom and maids bathroom.

Level Two: home study area, three generously proportioned bedrooms with master en-suite, a large terrace with incredible views, and the main family bathroom.

Roof Level: an expansive private roof terrace with 180-degree views across Dubai – perfect for relaxing and entertaining through the winter months. As currently arranged, it also features a home office, offering welcome separation from the main living space.

The residence is presented in fantastic condition throughout, with a warm, inviting tone reminiscent of a country home – a credit to the owner, who has invested considerably, both financially and with great care.

This combination of layout, views and condition is exceptionally rare within the community. Viewing is essential to appreciate how special this home is.

We cordially invite you to register your interest, request further details or arrange a private viewing soon to avoid disappointment.

descriptionHtml:
A collection of elegant villas set around a Wadi and lush green parkland beside Dubai Hills, in perfect proximity to the city’s vibrant heart.

A strong sense of community has been designed into every aspect of life at Eden Hills. Here, residents have so many opportunities to relax and enjoy the

trails and shady gathering spaces beautiful landscaping and activities including walking.

Close to the gated entrance lies a welcoming community center where residents can enjoy shopping and dining as well as club recreation facilities.

Set in thoughtfully designed surroundings, the villas has been designed to complement the natural beauty of the green landscape. Available with five, five plus and six bedrooms, they sit in harmony with the trees and lush planting.

With large expanses of glass and free-flowing interiors, there is an organic simplicity to each villa; exquisitely designed, beautifully crafted and precisely constructed. The villas also come with generous outdoor spaces, perfect for recreation and entertaining.

descriptionHtml:
A home unlike anything else, currently available in JBR.

This spectacular fully upgraded duplex loft in Bahar 4 has been completely transformed into a contemporary designer residence, combining dramatic proportions, beautiful interiors and incredible views in one of Dubai’s most established beachfront locations.

The moment you enter, the apartment makes an impression. Soaring approximately 7-metre double-height ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows create an exceptional sense of space and light, while the open staircase and upper-level mezzanine give the home its distinctive loft character.

The interiors are anything but generic: the apartment comes fully furnished with carefully selected designer pieces, including statement furniture that gives the home a sophisticated yet playful personality.

Set on a high floor, the property enjoys beautiful water, Palm and Ain Dubai views, making the outlook just as impressive as the interiors.

Property Highlights:

  • Exceptional duplex loft layout
  • 1,724 sq ft / approximately 160 sqm
  • Fully and extensively upgraded
  • Approx. 7-metre double-height ceiling
  • High floor
  • Palm, Ain Dubai and water views
  • Fully furnished with designer furniture
  • Statement open-plan kitchen with island
  • Bright, expansive living and dining area
  • Built-in wardrobes
  • 4 bathrooms
  • 2 dedicated parking spaces
  • Ready for its new tenant

The building also offers a shared swimming pool, gym, security and covered parking, while its location places you directly in the heart of JBR. The Walk is moments away, with the beach, restaurants, cafés, shops and everyday conveniences all within the neighbourhood.

This property is ideal for a tenant who wants more than another standard Dubai apartment. It offers the space of a large residence, the character of a New York-style loft and the lifestyle of JBR — all wrapped into a genuinely unique home.

Contact us today to arrange a private viewing.

The Peninsula Dubai Residences

An exceptional waterfront address in Jumeirah, The Peninsula Dubai Residences is ideally positioned where the Dubai Canal meets the Arabian Gulf.

Designed by world-renowned architectural practice RSHP, The Peninsula combines contemporary architecture with sophisticated interiors, expansive curved terraces and breathtaking panoramic views of the sea, marina and Dubai skyline.

Gracefully embracing a beautiful private marina, this exclusive destination comes alive in the mesmerising glow of sunrise and sunset, offering an unparalleled waterfront lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most desirable and well-connected locations.

Property Features:

  • 2 Bedrooms
  • 3 Bathrooms
  • Maid’s Room
  • Total Area: 3,004 sqft
  • Internal Area: 2,377 sqft
  • Balcony Area: 627 sqft
  • Full Sea & Marina Views

Designed around a private marina, The Peninsula offers a refined resort-style living experience with two swimming pools, a state-of-the-art gym, wellness facilities and a dedicated kids’ club.

Residents can also enjoy beautifully landscaped boulevards, luxury boutiques, art galleries and destination dining, creating a sophisticated community where waterfront living meets exceptional convenience.

A rare opportunity to experience elevated waterfront living in one of Dubai’s newest and most exclusive addresses.

Get in touch for more information or to arrange a private viewing.

descriptionHtml:
One at Palm Jumeirah, Dorchester Collection, Dubai, is a completely reimagined approach to elegance and exclusivity. Iconic architecture, sprawling layouts, unbeatable amenities, lush green spaces, and the most sought-after interior features make One at Palm Jumeirah more than a residence – it is a veritable masterpiece of artful design and the pinnacle of luxurious living in all its aspects.

Completed in 2006, Palm Jumeirah is unquestionably Dubai’s most spectacular location and a world icon. A marvel of modern engineering, the island boasts pristine beaches surrounded by the crystal blue waters of the Arabian Gulf – a prime destination for those who can appreciate an ultra-exclusive lifestyle. This one-of-a-kind setting now features a remarkable collection of stunning residences at its most prime position.

The timeless elegance of your home at One at Palm Jumeirah deserves a backdrop that sets it off like a precious jewel in an elegant setting. Floor-to-ceiling glass enables you to look out over sweeping, 360-degree vistas of the Gulf and the exciting Dubai skyline in an inspiring, ever-changing display of sea, sky and light.

Cutting-edge architecture, exclusively designed luscious interiors, the seamless coherence of privacy and association, make your home at One at Palm Jumeirah, Dorchester Collection, Dubai truly a cut above everything else. But what makes One at Palm Jumeirah even more spectacular is the sense of freedom, infinity and true bliss that comes from enjoying daily views that encompass everything

on the horizon and beyond.

Welcome to your home, where minimalist beauty meets an exquisite, staggered layout. The strikingly consonant design of One at Palm Jumeirah gives you both privacy and interaction. descriptionHtml:
Situatedon the crescent of the world-renowned landmark, Palm Jumeriah, ORLAoccupies a beachfront position right at the pinnacle of Dubai’sarchipelago.

Yourresidence at ORLA is your exclusive escape, where indoor and outdoorblend seamlessly with sea and sky, as energising light streamsthrough each residence creating eternal vistas from the moment thesun rises above the horizon to the last golden rays shimmering offthe sea below.
Offeringthe finest amenities and five-star service, for the pleasure ofresidents of ORLA’s 85 residences, 3 sky palaces, and 1 luxurymansion, you will find privacy, prestige and personalised servicefrom the moment you set foot in the vast, elevated lobby.

ORLAimmerses you in balance and beauty, fostering a deep connection withyour space and surroundings. The architecture is conceptualisedthrough the lens of natural elements, integrating flowing waterfeatures and lush greenery to erase boundaries and let positiveenergy flow through the property.

Organicby design, ORLA’s towers are linked together to optimise the windflow to assist in channelling the cooling breezes to the residencesand situated to allow residents to enjoy both sunrise and sunsetexperiences.

EachORLA residence has a seamless arrival experience unique to each homewith the discerning choice of a direct lift arrival experience,stepping from lift into your light filled residence within moments,for the most impressive entrance. Alternative front door entrancesare also available, so you still have the freedom to choose howguests can enter your ORLA residence.

ORLA’s85 tower residences and 3 sky palaces are a mix of two, three andfour-bedroom units floating above the resort and shimmering sea. Eachhave a unique layout spread over one or two storeys, ensuring thebest use of each space and providing an array of options to suitevery resident’s individual desires.

Aniconic luxury peninsula with a unique connection to the sea, the PalmJumeirah is a destination without peer, with many of Dubai’s finestrestaurants, clubs and beach resorts only moments away, while therest of the wonders of Dubai lie within easy reach.

Luxury Realty, the home of mansions, penthouses and branded residences, is pleased to present this brand-new, never-lived-in, exclusive four-bedroom Royal Penthouse complimented with private pool and terrace at Six Senses Residences, The Palm Jumeirah.

Positioned on the highest floor along the iconic West Crescent, this residence commands spectacular open sea and sunset views, with a unique layout spanning 7,361 sq ft (684 sq m) total across four bedrooms plus maid's room and is delivered fully fitted and unfurnished. Handover is scheduled for September 2026.    

As Six Senses' first branded address in the UAE, this beachfront development pairs a boutique hotel with ultra-luxury residences on a private stretch of the Palm Jumeirah coastline. Coral-inspired architecture, with undulating rooflines and cellular facades, echoes the region's reef ecosystems.

  • Private beach and swimming pools

  • Children's soft play area, kids' club and function spaces

descriptionHtml:
Born out of unrivaled craftsmanship, visionary design, and a profound sense of place, Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina emerges as an address unlike any other.

Soaring 122 stories above the pulsating heart of one of Dubai’s most coveted addresses, the extraordinary tower provides an unparalleled living experience, effortlessly blending with the dynamic energy and vibrancy of Dubai's global metropolis.  

Reflecting a shared philosophy between its design and ‘The City of the Future’, Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina presents itself on the world stage as the tallest residential tower of its time.

Set to transform the Dubai Marina skyline, this iconic structure not only reaches unprecedented heights but is a testament to progressive design and architectural excellence.

With a slender silhouette, its outer facade serves as a canvas of meticulous elegance, seamlessly integrating into the dynamic landscape of Dubai Marina, distinctly asserting its character while rightfully taking its place as a timeless landmark of the city.

Showcasing 251 exquisite residences, Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina features an array of unit typologies and sizes, ranging from two-to-four bedroom deluxe residences, four-bedroom half-floor penthouses, to ultra-luxurious four-and five-bedroom duplex and triplex Sky Mansions.

Each of the residences is meticulously designed to promote sustainability, well-being and contentment, integrating Sleep With Six Senses bedroom amenities and incorporating elements inspired by biophilia and classical feng shui.

The residences command sweeping panoramas that capture the entirety of Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Harbour Beachfront, Emirates Golf Course, Dubai Marina, Blue Waters, and Ain Dubai.

Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina is scheduled for completion in 2028.

descriptionHtml:
For over three decades, The Chedi has been synonymous with timeless elegance, refined hospitality, and seamless integration of heritage and modernity. From the pristine shores of Oman to the cultural vibrance of Japan, The Chedi’s global portfolio of award-winning destinations embodies a unique philosophy of understated luxury. Now, this esteemed legacy arrives in Dubai with The Chedi Private Residences—a landmark development offering an unprecedented lifestyle experience.

Ideally located on Sheikh Zayed Road, this groundbreaking development is the world’s first standalone private branded residence under The Chedi name.

Soaring 240 meters over 52 floors, this architectural marvel, with its sleek glass faÇade, is masterfully designedby the award-winning Studio Bruno Guelaff. Redefining

grandeur, The Chedi Private Residences presents an exclusive collection of sky villas and world-class amenities, offering a lifestyle beyond the extraordinary.

Discover an exclusive collection of expansive residences, ranging from two- to five-bedroom villas and duplexes to the extraordinary triplex Pinnacle Mansion—a one-of-a-kind masterpiece crowning the building. Experience unparalleled luxury and design in every detail.

The Chedi Private Residences perfectly balances this captivating energy and sophistication with the serenity of an exclusive retreat. From the elegant arrival  

experience to the exclusive rooftop residents’ Sky Social, every space is thoughtfully crafted to foster meaningful connections while providing a serene atmosphere

for personal reflection. Each area achieves a harmonious balance, seamlessly blending opportunities for social engagement with moments of tranquil solitude.

The Chedi Private Residences offers an exceptional range of premium amenities across three distinct levels: Ground Social, Resort Social, and Sky Social. Each level is meticulously designed to enrich the resident experience, offering curated spaces for relaxation, entertainment, and social engagement. The Ground and Resort levels feature a blend of essential amenities and leisure spaces, while the Sky Social level offers an exclusive atmosphere with an adults-only infinity pool, Omakase experience, Sky Bar & Lounge, ensuring a luxurious living experience at every turn.

descriptionHtml:
Rising high above the gentle flow of the Marasi Bay, VELA, Dorchester Collection, Dubai, is a sublime celebration of contemporary waterfront in Dubai.

Inspiring architecture, spacious design and wonderful views meet to create a place of true beauty.

Bringing together the vibrancy of Downtown Dubai with the peace and prestige of the Marasi Bay waterfront, VELA presents a doorway to an elevated way of life, immersed in beauty and surrounded by energy.

The immediate access to the tranquility of the sea, directly from your own marina mooring is extremely special.

Rising at 150-metre-tall, VELA provides a gross floor area of 272,860 sq. ft. spread over 30 floors. The 38 residences range in size from 4,253 sq. ft. to 11,727 sq. ft. and encompass sumptuous penthouses and three- and four-bedroom properties, some with double height living spaces and private terrace pools.

The tower is crowned by the Sky Palace which covers 22,992 sq. ft. spread over 3 floors with two swimming pools, grand terraces, a private gym and majlis.

VELA has been crafted by award-winning practice Foster + Partners, the masterminds behind Apple’s California headquarters, France’s dramatic Millau Viaduct and London’s ‘Gherkin’ tower. The firm has garnered various awards, including the coveted Pritzker Prize in 1999.

Life at the Marina Residences moves like the gentle flow of water. Here, the energy of the Marasi Marina fuels a lively pace of life that dances its own path through the promenade. For this is a new way of living in the city of Dubai, full of fresh moments that calm the mind and free the spirit.

Life at the Marina Residences moves like the gentle flow of water. Here, the energy of the Marasi Marina fuels a lively pace of life that dances its own path through the promenade. For this is a new way of living in the city of Dubai, full of fresh moments that calm the mind and free the spirit.

Spectacularly located in the Burj Khalifa District, VELA is the latest addition to upcoming ultra-luxury waterfront destination, curated with discretion and discernment by Dubai’s defining developer.

Drawing success from the neighboring The Lana Hotel and Residences, Dorchester Collection, Dubai, and inspired to reshape Marasi Bay, VELA embodies the higher realms of possibility and sophistication that is set to define this iconic destination.

descriptionHtml:
Experience the pinnacle of luxury in this exclusively listed, turnkey 2-bedroom residence at the globally celebrated Atlantis, The Royal.

Situated on a coveted high floor and available immediately, this fully furnished masterpiece offers an elite lifestyle paired with sweeping, panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf.

The Residence:

  • Bespoke Interiors: Impeccably furnished to exacting standards, featuring custom pieces and a flawless contemporary aesthetic.
  • Panoramic Vistas: Floor-to-ceiling windows wrap around expansive open-plan living areas, framing endless ocean views.
  • Gourmet Kitchen: A seamlessly integrated kitchen equipped with state-of-the-art Gaggenau appliances, perfect for entertaining.
  • Private Sanctuaries: Two generous en-suite bedrooms offering bespoke walk-in closets and opulent marble bathrooms.
  • Exclusive & Ready: Solely listed and completely vacant, ensuring a seamless move-in process for the right tenant.

Atlantis The Royal Highlights:

  • Residents enjoy privileged access to an unparalleled luxury resort ecosystem:
  • Culinary Excellence: 17 premier dining venues featuring celebrity chef concepts like Nobu by the Beach and Dinner by Heston Blumenthal.
  • Elevated Leisure: Access Cloud 22, the spectacular 90-meter sky pool, private resident-only pools, and pristine beachfront.
  • World-Class Wellness: Rejuvenate at the expansive Awaken Spa or train in the elite fitness centers.
  • White-Glove Service: 24/7 residential concierge, valet parking, and à la carte in-residence services.

The Palm Jumeirah Lifestyle:

Anchored on the crescent of Palm Jumeirah, this address provides the ultimate island retreat. Enjoy an exclusive resort oasis with immediate access to vibrant beach clubs, retail at Nakheel Mall, and the scenic Palm Boardwalk, while remaining effortlessly connected to Dubai Marina and the wider city.

Contact our team to make a private viewing without delay and secure your place at this prestigious address!

descriptionHtml:
Luxury Realty are delighted to present this exclusive 5 bedroom Chorisia 2 villa facing the lagoon for rent.

Inspired by one of the most beautiful trees in the world, these semi-detached villas are meticulously designed and planned to complement Al Barari’s existing portfolio. The collection of exquisite five-bedroom villas offers distinctive green living with inspired architecture and captivating views amid a relaxed and elegant atmosphere.

Chorisia 2 offers 5 ensuite bedrooms, an open living and dining area, an entrance hall, a covered garage, an open kitchen that is flexible to be closed with its amenities (laundry room, maids room), a powder room, and an office space. Designed with a connection to nature at the core, floor-to-ceiling glass that gazes upon the beautiful central courtyard. The office, kitchen, and living spaces open to the interior courtyard and to an outdoor garden and private pool.

Offering an unprecedented approach to sustainable living where family interaction and development is a focus. A unique destination. A place where you can live, stay, play, shop, dine, and work. From the Arabic word meaning ‘wilderness’, Al Barari is the region’s first integrated luxury and active eco-conscious development. A strategically located green community in the heart of the city provides an environment that enhances wellness for residents and visitors alike. Residents can immerse themselves in the abundant greenery surrounded by a sparkling waterway.
